verdict.rationale: Granola documents a few product-native actions that span many notes at once: a one-click CSV export of all historical notes, Chat queries run across all meetings or a folder, and a retention policy that auto-deletes transcripts in bulk. There is no documented general bulk-operations capability for selecting many notes and acting on them together. missing for 10: multi-select bulk edit/move/delete/tag of notes, bulk-apply templates or recipes across many notes, API batch endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You're able to export historical data from Granola by going to Settings, clicking Profile in the sidebar (under Preferences), and clicking Generate CSV
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Granola allows you to automatically delete transcripts after a set period of time.
